sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
when Δ P = 0.6 bar orafter 150 Op.Hrs as indicated in the above titled block.

The first draft is initiated by eng. Saad Samra, tested by eng. Mohamed Abdel 
Azeem at 28 June 2003, accepted by by General Manager eng. Mohamed El-Sarrag, 
revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abouda El-Bana, and approved by eng. 
Moneer Mahmoud El-Wakeel Damietta CCPS Head Sector.
المواصفات الفنية
احتياطات السلامة

تصريح عمل 
 يجب أن يتم إصدارها ويجب أن يحملها موظفو الصيانة المؤهلون 
 فئة السلامة،

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Wear safety helmet, and safety shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.

Isolate the filter mechanically by 
 closing inlet & outlet valves.
قم بإلغاء تهوية الفلتر عن طريق فتح صمام إزالة الهواء قبل فتحه.
Drain the filter by opening the drain valve.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
تحقق من الضغط التفاضلي. (0 بار)
Dismantle the filter cover.
Pull off the filter to clean it.
Clean the filter.
Replace the filter if it is required.
Replace the gasket if it is required.
Insert the filter in its correct position.
Close the filter cover with gasket.
Close the drain valve.
Refill the oil filter with oil.

Breath the air from the filter by opening 
 the de-aerate valve, then close it.
Open the inlet & outlet valves.

Check the leakage and treat it by 
 retightening the filter if it is required.
